experience_compression.intro: The accumulated experience buffer below exceeds the 300-word budget. Compress it while preserving every distinct observable rule. Merge near-duplicates (same trigger, same signal). DO NOT invent new rules or drop a unique signal.
experience_compression.your_task:
Re-emit the experience as a bulleted list, ≤300 words total, each bullet ≤20 words. Order: most-applicable / most-general rules first; narrower or task-flavored rules last (though no rule may name a task).
Output the compressed list inside ONE fenced block, no prose outside:
```experience - - - ... ```
